package com.cowave.search.repository.cache

import com.cowave.search.repository.cache.entity.MallValkeyEntity
import com.cowave.shared.serialization.defaultJson
import io.kotest.core.spec.style.FunSpec
import io.kotest.matchers.shouldBe
import io.mockk.every
import io.mockk.mockk
import io.mockk.slot
import io.mockk.verify
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.ValueOperations

class MallValkeyRepositoryUnitTest : FunSpec({

    val redisTemplate = mockk<RedisTemplate<String, String>>()
    val valueOps = mockk<ValueOperations<String, String>>(relaxed = true)
    val repository = MallValkeyRepository(redisTemplate)

    beforeEach {
        every { redisTemplate.opsForValue() } returns valueOps
    }

    test("getAllByIds - Valkey에 존재하는 몰을 조회하면 엔티티 리스트를 반환한다") {
        val mall1 = MallValkeyEntity(mallId = 1, mallCode = "M001")
        val mall2 = MallValkeyEntity(mallId = 2, mallCode = "M002", mallIdDanawa = "D002")

        every { valueOps.multiGet(any<Collection<String>>()) } returns listOf(
            defaultJson.encodeToString(MallValkeyEntity.serializer(), mall1),
            defaultJson.encodeToString(MallValkeyEntity.serializer(), mall2),
        )

        val result = repository.getAllByIds(listOf(1, 2))

        result.size shouldBe 2
        result[0]?.mallId shouldBe 1
        result[0]?.mallCode shouldBe "M001"
        result[1]?.mallId shouldBe 2
        result[1]?.mallIdDanawa shouldBe "D002"
    }

    test("getAllByIds - Valkey에 존재하지 않는 키는 null로 반환한다") {
        val mall = MallValkeyEntity(mallId = 1, mallCode = "M001")

        every { valueOps.multiGet(any<Collection<String>>()) } returns listOf(
            defaultJson.encodeToString(MallValkeyEntity.serializer(), mall),
            null,
        )

        val result = repository.getAllByIds(listOf(1, 999))

        result.size shouldBe 2
        result[0]?.mallId shouldBe 1
        result[1] shouldBe null
    }

    test("getAllByIds - 빈 리스트를 조회하면 빈 결과를 반환한다") {
        every { valueOps.multiGet(any<Collection<String>>()) } returns emptyList()

        val result = repository.getAllByIds(emptyList())

        result shouldBe emptyList()
    }

    test("setAll - 엔티티 리스트를 Valkey에 저장한다") {
        val mall1 = MallValkeyEntity(mallId = 1, mallCode = "M001")
        val mall2 = MallValkeyEntity(mallId = 2, mallCode = "M002")
        val capturedMap = slot<Map<String, String>>()

        every { valueOps.multiSet(capture(capturedMap)) } returns Unit

        repository.setAll(listOf(mall1, mall2))

        verify { valueOps.multiSet(any()) }
        capturedMap.captured.size shouldBe 2
        capturedMap.captured.keys.any { it.contains("mall") && it.endsWith(":1") } shouldBe true
        capturedMap.captured.keys.any { it.contains("mall") && it.endsWith(":2") } shouldBe true
    }

    test("setAll - nullable 필드가 포함된 JSON이 올바르게 직렬화된다") {
        val mall = MallValkeyEntity(
            mallId = 42,
            mallCode = "M042",
            mallIdDanawa = null,
            mallIdEnuri = "E042",
            mallUseYnDanawa = null,
            mallUseYnEnuri = "Y",
        )
        val capturedMap = slot<Map<String, String>>()

        every { valueOps.multiSet(capture(capturedMap)) } returns Unit

        repository.setAll(listOf(mall))

        val storedJson = capturedMap.captured.values.first()
        val deserialized = defaultJson.decodeFromString(MallValkeyEntity.serializer(), storedJson)
        deserialized.mallId shouldBe 42
        deserialized.mallCode shouldBe "M042"
        deserialized.mallIdDanawa shouldBe null
        deserialized.mallIdEnuri shouldBe "E042"
        deserialized.mallUseYnDanawa shouldBe null
        deserialized.mallUseYnEnuri shouldBe "Y"
    }

    test("getKey - 올바른 키 포맷을 생성한다") {
        every { valueOps.multiGet(any<Collection<String>>()) } returns listOf(null)

        repository.getAllByIds(listOf(123))

        val expectedKeys = listOf("commerce-search.search-api.cache.mall:123")
        verify { valueOps.multiGet(expectedKeys) }
    }
})
